name: shon-mods
description: Shon's own Claude Code mods for futures research, prop-firm forward tests and AutoRank outreach

plugins.name: leak-lint
plugins.description: Warns when trading code introduces lookahead patterns

plugins.name: kill-ledger
plugins.description: Flags prompts that name a strategy the memory already killed

plugins.name: bad-data
plugins.description: Toasts when a call touches a known-defective data file

plugins.name: forward-pane
plugins.description: /forward: pane of live launchd forward-test jobs

plugins.name: prereg
plugins.description: /prereg with SHA256, and a lock on pre-registrations once results exist

plugins.name: profile
plugins.description: /profile: switch which plugin set loads next session (trading/business/coding/all)

plugins.name: health-band
plugins.description: Red/amber band for API credit errors, LSE key, stale feeds and jobs

plugins.name: autorank-pane
plugins.description: /autorank: follow-ups due, first touches, replies and leads

plugins.name: folder-guard
plugins.description: Refuses new files loose in ~, ~/Desktop, ~/Documents

plugins.name: verdict-line
plugins.description: Status line with the current test's PF, t, p and PASS/FAIL

plugins.name: cost-gate
plugins.description: Warns when trading code sets zero or below-measured costs; /costs

plugins.name: variant-counter
plugins.description: /variants per idea from the experiment ledger; toast past 20 variants

plugins.name: holdout-vault
plugins.description: Seals confirmed holdout files: read-only, opening one asks and logs a burn

plugins.name: null-first
plugins.description: /nulls; toast when a verdict has no null test that lost

plugins.name: claim-check
plugins.description: Toasts PF/Sharpe/win-rate/t numbers in a reply that no tool output backs; /claims

plugins.name: experiment-ledger
plugins.description: /experiments: every write_verdict() run, per idea, with kill status

plugins.name: long-run
plugins.description: Sends long backtests to the background and notifies when they finish

plugins.name: data-index
plugins.description: /dataindex and /data: index of every bar file with range, gaps, roll method, defects

plugins.name: cost-band
plugins.description: Session $ and cache ratio in the status line; band at 80%/100% of the limit

plugins.name: sharpen
plugins.description: Turns a rough idea into a full brief before Claude works (auto for 15+ words, ++ to force, -- to skip, /sharpen for other AIs)

plugins.name: effort-router
plugins.description: Picks effort and ultracode per prompt (Haiku + calibration, keyword fallback); !low..!max, !ultra, !solo overrides

plugins.name: output-cap
plugins.description: Bash results over 150 lines: Claude reads the first and last 75 with a note of how many were cut

plugins.name: paste-dedupe
plugins.description: A paste repeated from an earlier prompt this session is sent as "same as message N"

plugins.name: usage-coach
plugins.description: Weekly-limit coach: status line, pace band, /budget, /next and a task queue with measured cost per task

plugins.name: memory-guard
plugins.description: Memory meter in the prompt footer, warn/critical band with Not now / Let Claude clean it (graceful quit only, after a confirm), /mem lists top users by app, chat and MCP server

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: One clean strip: live effort level and memory bar with small change animations; /hud place footer|band|hint|pane|off, saved for every new chat

plugins.name: chat-tidy
plugins.description: Once a day backs up chat transcripts, then archives chats idle 14+ days (never pinned, running or open); /tidy to preview
